description.content: Extend the offered and Yokoy-managed foreign exchange rates (Open Exchange Rates, CNB, NPB and NBS national bank rates) with your own customer-specific FX rates. The created FX rate sources are equivalent to Yokoy-managed FX rate sources and can be applied in **Admin > Company**, **General**. Currencies are assigned on a legal entity level.
Returns all foreign exchange rate sources.
